signal: Fleet raised a $27M Series B in June 2025 led by Ten Eleven Ventures after 6x revenue growth, with customers like Netflix, Stripe, and Uber.

email.body1:
Dustin, saw Fleet closed a $27M Series B after 6x revenue growth, with names like Netflix and Stripe already on board.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market enterprise and government accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Fleet off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dustin, quick follow-up for Fleet.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, especially in long enterprise and government cycles. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Fleet needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dustin, last bit of proof for Fleet.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fleet's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dustin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you grow enterprise and government, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know that stretch keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Fleet either way.
